big_case.notes: Whether registration under a statute silent on jurisdiction can supply consent to general jurisdiction after Mallory matters to every multistate corporation and to forum choice in Georgia and a few other States, so a merits ruling would have real commercial reach. But the vehicle was one plaintiff's default-judgment tort suit from a state intermediate court, it drew a single cert-stage amicus, and the Court denied at the first post-response conference without comment.
